checkpoint_populations.derived_how: by running isReportOnly from apps/api/src/lib/manifest-publication-policy.ts over the live rows and the manifest files, NOT by matching the 24-slug snapshot quoted in the 2026-10-27 handoff

exit_criterion_1_deploy_text_and_drift_a.correction_to_an_earlier_draft: an earlier draft attributed the 12 to being deactivated. That was wrong: manifest-text-sync.ts selects capabilities with no is_active filter, so a deactivated tool with a manifest is still checkpointed. The 12 are manifest-less; all 12 also happen to be deactivated, which is coincidence, not cause.
exit_criterion_1_deploy_text_and_drift_a.disposable_postgres_integration_test: PR #776's integration-db job passed (actions run 40555886853) and ci.yml runs `vitest run --no-file-parallelism integration.test.ts`, which selects manifest-text-sync.integration.test.ts. Whether it executed or skipped inside that job is NOT established by the job's pass.

exit_criterion_2_guaranteed_fields_measu.window: calls since the first recorded miss, 2026-10-29T13:38:12Z — not a 30-day window, which would inflate the denominators
exit_criterion_2_guaranteed_fields_measu.traffic_scope: served /v1/do calls via recordPiggybackResult on the dispatch and batch paths. That path does not distinguish the harness from customers, and roughly 98 percent of /v1/do volume is the harness sweep, so most of these are harness calls. Real traffic here means served production traffic, not customer traffic.
exit_criterion_2_guaranteed_fields_measu.pass_attribution: the sampled miss rows carry passed = true, so on those rows the misses are measure-and-alert only — a sample, not a proven invariant
exit_criterion_2_guaranteed_fields_measu.cause_not_diagnosed: checkGuaranteedFieldsPresent returns every guaranteed field as missing when the output root is not a plain object, so a multi-field miss has the shape of a root-level or early-return branch rather than independently absent fields. What is established is that the declaration and the response disagreed on a served call.
exit_criterion_2_guaranteed_fields_measu.why_it_matters: only 2 of the 16 (credit-score-band, timezone-lookup) appear in apps/api/scripts/manifest-consistency-allowlist.txt, the static checker's 22 known inconsistencies. The other 14 are invisible to static analysis and were found only by watching served responses — which is what H3's monitoring was built to do, and the concrete case for the weekly persisted-miss check the H3 handoff proposed, since at these volumes the live alert (more than 10 percent missing after at least 20 calls in one hour) will essentially never fire.
